prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in League City, Texas. Injury: neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1173; do not mention it.)
text: I was making a left turn at an intersection in League City, Texas, when another vehicle came through from the opposite direction and struck the front passenger side of my car. I had already slowed to a near stop and was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic, so I did not expect a collision at that speed. The impact pushed my car sideways and I felt my head snap forward and back against the headrest. Since the accident I have had persistent stiffness and pain in my neck, along with a dull ache across my lower back that gets worse when I sit or drive for long periods. I stopped at the scene, exchanged information with the other driver, and asked for medical attention, which I am still receiving. I am providing this account so the claim can be processed accurately and promptly.
